description: The web guard in the experimental layout's MUI user menu, every section locked: viewer with the probe's Guest role in the experimental layout. Every item of the user menu but Sign out is hidden and aria-disabled, the menu's first divider doesn't stay alone at the top, and opened with the pointer and with Enter the focus lands on Sign out, where the arrow keys keep it. Reads only.

steps.name: the guard has viewer's /Me (every section locked), the MUI app bar is up
open the user menu with the pointer
the menu
steps.eval: (() => { const m = document.getElementById('app-user-menu'); const list = m.querySelector('ul'); const children = [...list.children].filter((c) => getComputedStyle(c).display !== 'none').map((c) => c.tagName + ':' + c.textContent.trim()); const a = document.activeElement; return { visible: children, active: a ? a.textContent.trim() : null, jellyfinEnhancedEntry: !!m.querySelector('#jellyfinEnhancedUserMenuLink'), dividers: list.querySelectorAll('hr').length }; })()
